feats.title: Dragonborn Frenzy
feats.description: While you are bloodied, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls. At 11th level, this bonus increases to +3. At 21st level, it increases to +4.

feats.title: Dragonborn Senses
feats.description: You gain darkvision and a +2 feat bonus to Perception checks. At 21st level, this feat bonus increases to +3.

feats.title: Blood of Dragons
feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to all defenses against fear attacks, or a +4 if the attacker is a dragon.

feats.title: Draconic Guardian
feats.description: When you hit a creature with dragonfear, you can mark it until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Adaptable Breath
feats.description:
Choose a type of damage your dragon breath doesn't already deal from among acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison, necrotic, radiant. When you use your dragon breath racial power, you can choose to use this damage type rather than the normal damage dealt by the power. Only one damage type applies for a given dragon breath attack.

*Special:* You can take this feat more than once. Each time you select this feat, choose another damage type for your dragon breath power that you don't already have for it.

feats.title: Bolstering Breath
feats.description: Your dragon breath power targets enemies in the area, instead of all creatures in the area. In addition, allies in the area of your dragon breath gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Enlarged Dragon Breath
feats.description: When you use your Dragon Breath power, you can choose to make it blast 4 or 5 instead of blast 3. At 11th level you can additionally choose to make it blast 6, and at 21st level you can additionally choose to make it blast 7.

feats.title: Hurl Breath
feats.description: When you use your dragon breath, you can choose to make it an area burst 2 within 10 squares instead of a close blast 3.

feats.title: Surprising Breath
feats.description: When you hit a creature with your dragon breath, you gain combat advantage against that creature until the start of your next turn.
